## 1.1.0 (2026-10-30)

### ✨ New Features

* add experimental Remote ATV 6.1.0 ad-free patch f843486

patches.name: Emby client unlock
patches.description: Enables local in-app feature gates using Kirlif's observed approach. Does not grant server Premiere entitlements.

patches.name: Emby remove Firebase and DataTransport
patches.description: Removes Firebase/DataTransport SDK classes and manifest components. Disables Firebase push messaging; keeps Cast and billing libraries.

patches.name: Disable analytics collection
patches.description: Disables declared analytics and crash collection and removes advertising permissions. Keeps Firebase Messaging and location permissions. Does not guarantee zero tracking.

patches.name: Local lists and backups
patches.description: Adds BadFella Settings with 299 or 900 local lists, local task assignments, and manual or scheduled local backups of organization and supported task snapshots. Cloud lists and task ownership stay in TickTick; attachment file contents are not included.

patches.name: Restore notifications
patches.description: Restores Firebase certificate metadata on re-signed apps, with an Android 17 compatible token setup. Push delivery still requires device testing.

patches.name: Restore reminder alarms
patches.description: Restores task/reminder alarm scheduling on re-signed apps.

patches.name: TickTick Premium
patches.description: Enables client-side premium features and limits. Does not grant server-side AI access or a subscription.

patches.name: Remote ATV ad-free
patches.description: Disables ad initialization/loading and advertising IDs, removes PairIP startup protection and reduces declared analytics collection. Does not claim zero tracking.

release_notes:
## Remote for Android TV — experimental community testing

Adds **Remote ATV ad-free** for the unmodified **6.1.0 APKM**, with ARMv7, ARM64 and x86-64 support. The patch suppresses ad loading and advertising-ID access, reduces declared analytics collection, and restores protected startup code.

Emulator startup, settings, three cold starts and 11 ad API checks passed, including six expected failure callbacks. App-specific Dart code and purchase state are unchanged; the stock Activate premium UI remains. This does not claim every tracker has been removed.

**Please test TV discovery/pairing, keyboard, voice, navigation, app shortcuts and power controls. Physical TV and ARM-device behavior have not been verified yet.**

### Install and report feedback

1. Update or refresh **BadFella Patches** in Morphe Manager to **1.1.0**.
2. Select **Remote for Android TV** and choose the stock **6.1.0 APKM**. If Manager labels that matching version experimental or "Unsupported Version", choose **Proceed anyway**. Open the **BadFella Patches** tab, enable **Remote ATV ad-free**, then tap **Patch**. Enable Expert Mode if custom app selection is hidden.
3. Keep the same Manager signing key when updating an existing patched installation.
4. [Report feedback](https://github.com/XBadFellaX/BadFella-Patches/issues) with the patch/app versions, phone and TV models, Android versions, reproduction steps, and whether the issue also happens with stock. Remove credentials and pairing codes from logs.

[Add to Morphe](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=XBadFellaX/BadFella-Patches)

The existing five TickTick patches and two Emby patches remain included. TickTick local lists/backups remain optional and off by default. Server-side AI and subscription entitlements are unchanged.
